issues.summary: Vercel /api/readyz returns 503 because the existing DATABASE_URL is rejected as tenant/user not found.
issues.impact: Public guest discovery works, but database-backed account, bookmark, feedback, and persistence routes are not release-ready.
issues.requiredAction: Restore or unpause the intended Supabase project and replace DATABASE_URL with its current pooler connection string, then rerun readyz and persistence E2E.

issues.summary: A saved draft records the three place IDs, but re-entry requests a fresh recommendation instead of restoring an expired or replaced trio exactly.
issues.impact: Initial deterministic recommendations usually reopen consistently; a previously replaced or time-sensitive trio can change on re-entry.
issues.requiredAction: Add a stateless, validated restore contract for saved place IDs or explicitly invalidate non-reproducible drafts before public release.

issues.summary: The current KTO proxy call returns HTTP 429.
issues.impact: This is treated as provider failure, never NO_ASSET. Thirty reviewed KTO photos and twenty-one Google photos remain available; ten locations show the designed fallback.
issues.requiredAction: Confirm or raise the KTO service quota before relying on live gallery refresh.

issues.summary: Ten locations still have no photo meeting the GOAT visual threshold.
issues.impact: The UI is functional and unbroken, but those cards use the explicit fallback instead of an overseas-mood representative photo.
issues.requiredAction: Obtain a licensed official or Google Places candidate that passes the existing threshold; do not lower the threshold automatically.

issues.summary: Google and Kakao provider consoles were not available for callback allow-list verification.
issues.impact: Guest P0 is unaffected; optional login cannot be declared production-ready.
issues.requiredAction: Allow-list the production callback under https://goat-api-lac.vercel.app and execute provider login E2E.
